command.label: Command
command.description: The nan-usage executable. Give it an absolute path if the shell Noctalia spawns cannot reach it.

interval.label: Redraw interval (seconds)
interval.description: How often the tool prints a record. It polls the NaN API on its own schedule (poll_seconds in its own configuration); this only decides how often the countdown is redrawn.

show_icon.label: Show the NaN logo
show_icon.description: Draw the NaN logo before the text. It replaces the glyph; if it does not appear, this Qt build has no SVG image support, so use the glyph instead.

show_glyph.label: Show a glyph
show_glyph.description: Draw a glyph before the text.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: The glyph to draw when Show a glyph is on.

show_tooltip.label: Details in the tooltip
show_tooltip.description: Show a line per model, with tokens used against the cap and the projection, when you hover the widget.

left_click.label: What a left click does
left_click.description: Open Noctalia's own panel for this plugin (no compositor configuration needed), open the GTK popup window instead, or do nothing.

icon_style.label: Logo style
icon_style.description: Ghost draws the mark in the theme's own ink, which sits in a row of glyphs; Color draws it as NaN does.

panel.title: NaN Usage
panel.open_failed: Could not open the NaN panel
panel.no_opener: No program to open a link with: install xdg-utils (or gio from glib2)
panel.waiting_hint: The bar widget starts it; if it is not there, run nan-usage doctor.
